full_text:
AMIR MISHAYEV

Amir.Mishayev@gmail.com LinkedIn GitHub  0526880371

B.Sc. Software Engineering. Passionate about learning, writing clean, reliable code and collaborating closely with teammates to turn ideas into polished products. Eager to join an environment that challenges me, nurtures growth and lets me contribute fresh energy to meaningful software.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

React · Node.js · Python · Java · JavaScript/TypeScript · Flutter/Dart · REST/GraphQL · MySQL · MongoDB · Firebase · Supabase · Git · Agile Scrum · Unity · AWS

PROJECTS

Gym Classes Registration App:
Situation: Local gym used error-prone spreadsheets for class sign-ups.
Action: Building a mobile app with secure Supabase Auth, real-time booking and capacity dashboards.
Result (in rollout): Aiming to cut front-desk registration time and data errors; metrics will be added post-launch.

Recipe Website:
Situation: Course project to practice React & UI design.
Action: Built responsive site hosting 30+ recipes with search & category filters.
Result: Delivered a smooth, mobile-first user experience that highlights front-end performance and UX best practices.

Real-Time Call Translation App:
Situation: Global teams still struggle with voice-preserved, low-latency translation in Hebrew, English & Russian.
Action: capstone R & D of a modular speech-to-speech pipeline—streaming Whisper for ASR, Google NMT for context-aware translation, and Coqui xTTS voice-cloning for natural playback.
Result: Designing a mobile app that turns multilingual calls into seamless native-language conversations while keeping each speaker’s voice identity.

Scientific Citation Network Reconstruction:
Situation: Simulated 30% citation loss across 500 runs.
Action: Trained GraphSAGE GNN (Python + PyTorch Geometric) to predict missing links.
Result: Restored ~48k citations and visualized impact-factor shifts, demonstrating graph-ML expertise.

Secure Payment App:
Situation: Needed proof of concept for encrypted payments.
Action: Implemented EC-DH key exchange, Schnorr signatures and IDEA-OFB encryption.
Result: Achieved end-to-end confidentiality & integrity aligned with modern crypto practices.

EDUCATION
Graduate B.Sc. in Software Engineering | Braude, Karmiel
Relevant Coursework: Data Structures, Algorithms, Object-Oriented Programming, Web & Cloud Development, Network Security, Deep Learning

MILITARY SERVICE
IDF Naval Unit 3 – Combat Soldier & Fitness Instructor.

LANGUAGES
Hebrew (native), English (fluent), Russian (intermediate)
